definitions.explanation: A magazine or periodical that is published once every three months, four times a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{季刊誌|きかんし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}→春夏秋冬：14856_shunkashuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧4⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}される→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧。
examples.english: This quarterly magazine is published four times a year in spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季刊誌|きかんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}った→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: My paper was published in the academic society's quarterly journal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧{季刊誌|きかんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧みた。
examples.english: I visited a shop that was featured in the local tourism quarterly.

notes:
{季刊誌|きかんし} is a compound of {季|き} (season/quarter) + {刊|かん} (publication) + {誌|し} (magazine). Published four times a year, once per season.

PUBLICATION FREQUENCY SERIES:
- ⟦{日刊|にっかん}→日刊：19258_nikkan⟧: daily publication
- ⟦{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}→週刊誌：11179_shuukanshi⟧: weekly magazine
- ⟦{隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}→隔週刊：26653_kakushuukan⟧: biweekly
- ⟦{月刊誌|げっかんし}→月刊誌：11513_gekkanshi⟧: monthly magazine
- {季刊誌|きかんし}: quarterly magazine
- {年刊|ねんかん}: annual publication

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季刊誌|きかんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to publish a quarterly
- {季刊誌|きかんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}する→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to publish in a quarterly

USAGE:
Used for both general-interest magazines and academic journals (⟦{学術|がくじゅつ}→学術：12280_gakujutsu⟧{季刊誌|きかんし}). The term ⟦{季刊|きかん}→季刊：02787_kikan⟧ alone can modify other nouns: ⟦{季刊|きかん}→季刊：02787_kikan⟧⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧ (quarterly report).
